top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs a checkable prediction (the 2011 continuum model giving flat bands at a magic angle) with an independent 2018 experimental discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting states, since reproduced by many groups with transport, STM and compressibility probes. The citation can stay clear of the unsettled pairing mechanism. The allocation to MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero and Bistritzer is defensible, though the Andrei and Cao attribution question remains. P002 (optical lattice clock) is a mature and reproducible achievement, but it reads more as a new measurement regime that follows the 2005 and 2012 recognitions, so I rank it second ahead of no award.
